title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s Star-Studded Wedding Guests Arrive at MSG Ahead of Ceremony
summary: Ed Sheeran, Camila Cabello, Jack Antonoff and more celebs arrived in New York City ahead of the couple's July 3 wedding.
contentText:
Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce ‘s star-studded guest list is arriving in New York City ahead of the couple’s highly anticipated wedding ceremony.

As anticipation builds for the nuptials, dozens of celebrities were spotted making their way to Madison Square Garden, where the pop superstar and Kansas City Chiefs tight end are expected to tie the knot on Friday (July 3).

Among those seen arriving were Swift’s longtime collaborator Jack Antonoff , the singer’s best friend Abigail Anderson, and close friend Gigi Hadid, who attended with boyfriend Bradley Cooper. Dakota Johnson and Mariska Hargitay were also spotted heading to the iconic venue, according to People .

Ed Sheeran and his wife, Cherry Seaborn, were also seen before the celebration, while Lena Dunham and the Haim sisters made their way to the venue. Ellie Goulding was photographed arriving, Benson Boone was spotted outside Madison Square Garden, and Camila Cabello shared a TikTok video documenting her ride to the event.

The Chicks appeared to share a pre-wedding selfie on Instagram , while Sombr posted a TikTok video of himself dressed for the occasion. Other musicians reportedly seen ahead of the ceremony included Brad Paisley, Aaron Dessner, Lucy Dacus, Miranda Lambert, MGK, The Chainsmokers, Rascal Flatts’ Joe Don Rooney and Kelsea Ballerini.

The sports world was also well represented. Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford, sports broadcaster Charissa Thompson, and former NFL cornerback Richard Sherman were seen leaving their hotel, while San Francisco 49ers tight end George Kittle and his wife, Claire, arrived together, according to  People . Athletes Kyle Juszczyk, Cooper Kupp, Julian Edelman, Jared Wiley, Justin Thomas, Chris Jones, Mecole Hardman Jr., Abby Wambach, and New England Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel were also seen.

Additional celebrity guests spotted included Hugh Grant, Ethan Hawke, Jimmy Fallon, Tommy Hilfiger, Karlie Kloss, Zoë Kravitz, Jason Sudeikis, Julianne Moore, George Stephanopoulos, Graham Norton, Bowen Yang and Nikki Glaser.

The festivities began the night before. On Thursday (July 2), guests were seen arriving at Madison Square Garden for the couple’s rehearsal dinner, People reports.

Fans have been eagerly awaiting Swift and Kelce’s big day for weeks, with speculation surrounding the wedding’s date and location reaching a fever pitch in June after reports surfaced that the couple would host their ceremony at Madison Square Garden over Fourth of July weekend.
